Method of Attack: Backdoor on-premise Microsoft Exchange servers using PowerShell-based malware
Deploying a web shell to steal user credentials by monitoring clear text HTTP traffic and capturing credentials from webform data or HTTP headers
Backdoor servers using PowerShell, activated by scheduled tasks, leveraging Exchange server with EWS API for C2 communication
Impacted Systems: United Arab Emirates government organization systems
Attack Vector: Phishing email containing archived malicious executable
Basic authentication monitoring via web shell
Indicators of Compromise: File named System.Web.ServiceAuthentication.dll mimicking legitimate IIS file
Emails with subject 'Update Microsoft Edge' containing base64-encoded commands
Use of Exchange Web Services (EWS) API for command-and-control communication
